title: SAFE-DRIFT: Data Selection for Supervised Fine-tuning with Controllable Off-Target Drifts
abstract: arXiv:2611.28560v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose SAFE-DRIFT, a data-selection framework for supervised fine-tuning that improves a target capability while controlling unwanted drift in the model's other behaviors. We formalize this as a constrained optimization problem that maximizes alignment with the target gradient, subject to a budget on off-target drift which we quantify using the Fisher information of a reference distribution. Under this objective, the optimal, closed-form update is a damped natural-gradient step that downweights reference-sensitive directions. To estimate these high-dimensional gradients and work within the right geometry, we further derive a scalable algorithm that approximates the Fisher information and the target gradient in a shared low-dimensional subspace and analyze how entanglement of the target and reference task can affect the update. translated_title: SAFE-DRIFT：具有可控偏离目标漂移的监督微调数据选择方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了SAFE-DRIFT，这是一个用于监督微调的数据选择框架，能够在提升目标能力的同时控制模型其他行为中不期望出现的漂移。我们将该问题形式化为一个约束优化问题：在与目标梯度的对齐程度最大化的同时，满足对偏离目标漂移的预算约束，该漂移使用参考分布的Fisher信息进行量化。在该目标函数下，最优的闭式更新是一个阻尼自然梯度步骤，它会降低对参考分布敏感方向的权重。为了估计这些高维梯度并在正确的几何空间中进行计算，我们进一步推导了一种可扩展的算法，该算法在共享的低维子空间中近似Fisher信息和目标梯度，并分析了目标任务与参考任务的纠缠程度会如何影响更新。我们在包括共同……（摘要此处截断）在内的多个不同领域中，将SAFE-DRIFT与最先进的数据选择方法进行了评估比较。
tldr: 提出了SAFE-DRIFT数据选择框架，通过在以Fisher信息量化的偏离漂移预算约束下最大化目标梯度对齐的约束优化方法，使监督微调在提升目标能力的同时可控地限制模型其他行为的漂移。
